about: Valheim-style star bosses (Dom 2026-10-28: 'no switches, just get everything live'; the public Valheim wiki is the reference only). Any boss may stand as a 0-star (as before), 1-star or 2-star instance. `levels`: per star level, healthX / damageX (multipliers laid over the boss as a ?tune= map, src/tune.ts, so they multiply on top of the profile, difficulty rows, progression escalation (data/progression.json) and ?tune=), scaleX (the body's RENDER scale only: the sim's capsule, reach and ragdoll bones are untouched), `tell` (a gold emissive glow on the body, null = none; colour and intensity are the glow's), `trophy` (the per-kill reward row: a star kill adds one trophy of that tier to the save and shows 'Trophy: <name>'; no item art). The star roll is deterministic per spawn instance (src/stars.ts rollStar: hash32 of the spawn id + `salt`, stepped by that spawn's own kill count; no Math.random, no clock), so a replay or a test rolls the same star. A boss's FIRST encounter is always 0-star: a star can only roll once that boss kind has been killed `minKills` times (the save's kill count, else this visit's). `weights`: per difficulty row id (data/difficulty.json rows 1-10 and `legacy`) the weight of a 1-star and a 2-star against `zeroWeight` for a 0-star, each = base + perKill x min(kills of that boss, `killsCap`), so stars grow likelier with every kill. (Per-ring weights, data/rings.json, join these rows the same way once that file ships.) `starGlyph`: the HUD mark, one per star, drawn small beside the boss name in the bars (the class slot's style) in `hudColour`.
